description: This script sets up the database schema, policies, triggers, and storage for a bug tracking application using Supabase. It creates tables for users, projects, bugs, comments, notifications, and audit logs, along with associated policies and triggers.

methods.name: Optional[Client] get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for the URL and service role key.

methods.name: create_users_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates the users table with security policies and a trigger to handle new user registration.

methods.name: create_projects_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates the projects table with policies for access control.

methods.name: create_bugs_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates the bugs table with policies for bug management.

methods.name: create_comments_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates the comments table with access controls for commenting on bugs.

methods.name: create_notifications_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates notifications table for user notifications with policies.

methods.name: create_audit_logs_table(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates an audit logs table to track actions within the system.

methods.name: create_updated_at_trigger(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Creates triggers to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp on row modifications.

methods.name: setup_storage(supabase: Client)
methods.description: Configures storage buckets and access policies for bug attachments.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates the database setup process.
